summary: Preserve default same-origin zoom sharing across WebContents instead of treating zoom as always instance-local.

target.notes: Preserve Electron WebContents/Chromium renderer semantics through the ElectronCompat host boundary; do not replace navigation, rendering, printing, or DevTools with ordinary .NET calls.

semantics.default_mode: Chromium zoom is same-origin shared by default
semantics.cross_contents: other WebContents at same origin may observe zoom level
semantics.isolation: use isolated mode for per-WebContents behavior

tests.name: same-origin boundary
tests.expected_behavior: default mode may propagate zoom to b

tests.name: not CLR view property
tests.expected_behavior: cannot be modeled as a private numeric field only
